department: Department of Marine Science (Marine Science Institute)

deadline.value: All materials are due December 1 (2026 for Fall 2027); later applications go to an alternate list. Decisions before April 1.
deadline.quote: All application materials listed below must be received no later than December 1, for admission in Fall Semester. Applications completed after this date will be considered for an alternate list.

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires the GRE.
gre_general.quote: Our department no longer requires the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned.

supervisor.value: Admission depends on a faculty member being willing to supervise you; contact faculty whose research matches yours before applying.
supervisor.quote: Admission to our program is based on academic credentials AND willingness of a faculty member to supervise a prospective student. | We strongly encourage prospective students to make direct contact with individual faculty members whose research matches their own

funding.value: Every graduate student is fully supported (research or teaching assistantship or fellowship) with a living stipend plus tuition and fees.
funding.quote: Each of our graduate students is fully supported as a graduate research assistant, teaching assistant, or on a fellowship, with a stipend sufficient to cover living expenses and university tuition and fees.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in an appropriate science discipline (or foreign equivalent) with a GPA of at least 3.0 in upper-division work.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree in an appropriate science discipline from an accredited United States Institution or proof of equivalent training at an institution outside the United States

notes: Most of the program is based at the Marine Science Institute in Port Aransas, 200 miles south of Austin.
name: Marine Science
